description: This file is a C source code file implementing a Data Encryption Unit Driver for the AR9 platform, including hardware initialization functions for AES and DES, and related utility functions.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Swap data given to the function; currently returns input unchanged.

methods.name: aes_chip_init
methods.description: Initialize AES hardware by setting control register bits.

methods.name: des_chip_init
methods.description: Initialize DES hardware by setting control register bits and executing a sync instruction.
